method_note: Counted unique paper numbers (IAA-PDC-25-SS-NNN, SS = session) in the 9th IAA PDC (Stellenbosch, 5-9 May 2025) program dated 8 May 2025: 225 papers (oral + poster) across 11 numbered topical sessions. Paper counts chosen over session counts because the 10 oral sessions are single-track and differ widely in size. Weight = share of papers; sessions spanning two keywords split 50/50. Keynotes and 3 panel sessions (YR4/international collaboration, international disaster management, IYAAPD 2029) not counted. Planetary defense dominates by construction; secondary keywords show sub-themes (NEO survey/characterization science, missions, mission design, policy, education).
